item.title: TRANSFORMERS Star Shia LaBeouf Accused Of Alleged "Hate Crime" After "Terrorizing" New Orleans
item.description: New details have emerged about Transformers and Disturbia star Shia LaBeouf's recent Mardi Gras arrest, with one New Orleans local accusing the actor of an alleged hate crime.

item.title: FANTASTIC FOUR Star Doug Jones Would Return As Silver Surfer In The MCU - On One Condition (Exclusive)
item.description: Fantastic Four: Rise of the Silver Surfer star Doug Jones has revealed whether he would be open to reprising the role of Norrin Radd in the MCU if Marvel Studios came calling.

item.title: PEAKY BLINDERS: THE IMMORTAL MAN Trailer Brings Cillian Murphy Back As Tommy Shelby For One Final Fight
item.description: The first trailer for Peaky Blinders: The Immortal Man has been released by Netflix, revealing that Tommy Shelby is forced out of exile for one final fight when his son runs into trouble.

item.title: RUMOR: James Gunn Wants To Fast-Track THE BATMAN 3 So He Can "Move On" To THE BRAVE AND THE BOLD
item.description: According to a new rumour, James Gunn is eager to get Matt Reeves' The Batman 3 over and done with so he can move on to the DCU-set The Brave and the Bold as quickly as possible.

item.title: AVENGERS: ARMAGEDDON Event Revealed; Will Pit The Heroes Against Latveria's New Ruler: [SPOILER]
item.description: Marvel Comics has officially unveiled this year's Avengers: Armageddon event, revealing that Earth's Mightiest Heroes will assemble to replace Doctor Doom's successor in Latveria.

item.title: TOY STORY 5 Trailer And Poster Reunite The Gang As Sequel's Full Voice Cast Is Revealed
item.description: Pixar skipped the Super Bowl, but we now have a new trailer for Toy Story 5 that sees Woody reunite with Buzz Lightyear and Jessie to face their biggest challenge yet: technology.

item.title: TRON: ARES And TRON: ASCENSION Concept Art Reveal Scrapped Plans For Cillian Murphy To Become Sark
item.description: New concept art from TRON: Ares and the unmade TRON: Ascension reveals a first look at Cillian Murphy's transformation into the villainous Sark and unused Ares designs.
